title: OZONOXY 100 Pro
pageTitle: OZONOXY 100 Pro — professional ozone generator, 100 g/h
pageDescription: Professional ozone generator OZONOXY 100 Pro. Output 100 g/h, rooms up to 650 m³. Compact, high-reliability design.
shortDesc: Professional compact ozone generator with 100 g/h output. Treatable room volume up to 650 m³.
description: OZONOXY 100 Pro is a professional compact ozone generator with 100 g/h output. Built for intensive use on medium-sized sites. Its compact size and high reliability suit rooms up to 650 m³. Ideal for regular disinfection of production, warehouse, and commercial spaces.
features: No nitrogen oxide generation during ozone production
Oxygen feed via quick-connect fitting for up to 50% higher output
Metal enclosure with two-stage coating (zinc primer + cured enamel)
Fine filtration — prevents electrode degradation from dust and grease buildup
tasks: disinfection, pest control, rodent control, deodorization, detoxification
